steps: A support agent asks TicketFlow to check the status for alice at example dot com.
First, you send the message to Claude plus a tools array, with a lookup customer tool whose J S O N schema requires an email.
Claude does not answer yet. It emits a tool use block with the email argument, and the stop reason is not end turn.
Next, your dispatcher validates the email first. A malformed one, with no at sign, would get an error tool result back, with no crash. This one is valid.
The email passes, so the database query runs, and returns premium tier with two open tickets.
Now you append the tool result as a user message, and Claude replies with an end turn stop reason: Alice is premium.
Finally, the support agent gets a grounded answer, built on live data: Alice is premium, with two open tickets.
